identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.06] Build the operator attention inbox and intervention workflow

values.review_scope: Exact changed head across Runtime attention contract, schema/API integration, authorization composition, durable recovery, Observatory UI, focused proof, and issue-local documentation.
review_prompts: Does the queue contract prevent identity, urgency, authority, deduplication, or ordering spoofing under overload?
Are #111 conversation, #112 authority/audit, and #114 durability boundaries consumed without duplicated ownership?
Can restart, reconnect, partial write, corruption, expiry, and policy drift recover without loss, reordering, or duplicate notification?
Does every operator action re-authorize and avoid implying approval?
Are Observatory projections accessible, responsive, bounded, and free of private cognition, secrets, stale authority, and cross-principal leakage?
Does exact-head proof cover every AC with no fixture-only product claim?
